bullets: AI/semis selloff deepened on Lam Research's supply-chain warning; semis -12.9% and comms -5.8%, while staples/utilities rallied as money rotated to defensives.
Meta fell ~7% after AI spending pushed free cash flow negative, adding to tech jitters; VIX rose 14% to 19.0.
10Y Treasury yield tumbled below 5% to a near one-month low on flight-to-safety buying; Brent crude rose to $113.55 on supply concerns.
Asian/European shares wobbled on the tech rout; Flash PMIs and revised UoM consumer sentiment/inflation expectations due today in the US.

AMD.why: Dropped with the AI-trade selloff; Lam Research's Oct 21 supply-chain warning hit AMD, Marvell and Intel broadly. No company damage found: Susquehanna raised PT to $620, Wedbush reiterated Outperform. Ratings 44 buy/11 hold/0 sell.
AMD.bull: Sector-wide chip selloff looks overdone; Susquehanna and Wedbush just raised/reiterated bullish targets on AI data-center demand.
AMD.bear: AI capex sentiment is fragile post-Meta FCF miss; further supply-chain warnings could extend the chip-sector drawdown before it bottoms.

sources.title: Chip Stocks Fall as Supply Warning Deepens AI Selloff: Marvell and AMD Sink 8%, Intel Drops 7%

GME.why: Fell on dilution concerns from a $1.4B convertible-note-to-shares exchange plus profit-taking after a run to 52-week highs; an Oct 30 warrant expiration adds further dilution risk. No analyst coverage; rvol modest at 1.05.
GME.bull: Retail enthusiasm and CEO Cohen's buying spree keep sentiment supportive; an oversold bounce is possible after the sharp drop.
GME.bear: Active share dilution from the note exchange plus the Oct 30 warrant expiration is a real supply overhang, not just sentiment.

P.why: Dropped with a broader AI-stock selloff (Lumentum, Dell, Everpure all sold off) despite strong results and a Guggenheim upgrade to Buy, PT $215. CFO insider sale (5,112 shares) and stretched valuation add noise but no fundamental damage found.
P.bull: Fundamentals intact: Guggenheim just upgraded to Buy with a much higher PT; broad AI-stock selloff, not company-specific, drove the drop.
P.bear: Stock still trades well above GF fair value with recent insider selling; a sector bounce may not fully close the valuation gap.

MU.why: Fell more than the market with the chip-sector selloff tied to Lam Research's supply-chain warning, ahead of its own earnings. Ratings heavily bullish (45 buy/3 hold/1 sell); Rosenblatt and Needham reiterated Buy with high price targets. No company-specific negative found.
MU.bull: Deeply bullish analyst base (45 buy ratings) and a cheap forward P/E versus ~699% expected EPS growth argue for a sharp mean-reversion bounce.
MU.bear: The drop reflects real supply-chain cost/constraint risk flagged by Lam Research that could still pressure Micron's near-term margins.

sources.title: Micron (MU) Falls More Steeply Than Broader Market: What Investors Need to Know

BE.why: Beat Q3 revenue/EPS and raised Q4 guidance above estimates, but negative Q3 operating cash flow dampened sentiment post-earnings - a company-specific reaction, not sector. Baird raised PT to $351 (Outperform); Truist moved to Hold, PT $240.
BE.bull: Q3 revenue/EPS beat and above-consensus Q4 guidance show demand is strong; Baird raised its PT to $351 right after the print.
BE.bear: Negative Q3 operating cash flow is a real balance-sheet concern investors are penalizing, independent of the broader market mood.

ANET.why: Slumped ~18% from its Oct 9 record on profit-taking, routine insider selling (10b5-1 plans), and stretched AI-infrastructure valuation amid broader chip supply-chain jitters. TD Cowen trimmed PT to $205 but kept Buy. Ratings 31 buy/1 hold/0 sell.
ANET.bull: An 18% pullback from record highs looks like profit-taking after an AI-driven rally, not fundamental deterioration; ratings remain 31 buy/1 hold.
ANET.bear: Insider selling, stretched valuation, and live chip supply-chain constraints could keep pressuring the stock before it stabilizes.

MRVL.why: Fell with AMD/Intel on Lam Research's Oct 21 chip supply-chain warning tied to AI data-center spending; sector-wide, no company-specific damage found. Ratings 42 buy/4 hold/0 sell; no analyst downgrades recorded.
MRVL.bull: Sector-wide, catalyst-driven drop (Lam Research warning) with overwhelmingly bullish ratings (42 buy/4 hold) argues for a quick bounce.
MRVL.bear: Marvell's custom AI chips depend on hyperscaler capex that just got a supply-chain scare; sentiment could stay shaky near-term.
